name: codex-web-planner
description: Let ChatGPT plan and review while Codex executes the approved work.

interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex workflow that uses your own ChatGPT account for planning and review, while keeping execution in Codex.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex Web Planner for this task. On first use, automatically check the ChatGPT connection and run setup; pause only for the user's ChatGPT login, CAPTCHA, 2FA, or final consent. Then have ChatGPT plan and review while Codex executes only approved changes.
